title: storage: implement RedbTranscriptStore
description: Implement the TranscriptStore trait using redb as the persistence backend. This implementation provides a high-performance, ACID-compliant storage solution for conversation transcripts with support for transactions, crash recovery, and efficient key-value operations.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL implement the TranscriptStore trait for RedbTranscriptStore
THE SYSTEM SHALL persist all storage operations to disk using redb's transactional guarantees

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL serialize and store the transcript in a redb table within a transaction
THE SYSTEM SHALL open or create the redb database file at the configured path

unwanted.condition: IF the database file is corrupted
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT expose corrupted data to callers
unwanted.because: data integrity must be guaranteed even in failure scenarios

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT lose existing transcript data
unwanted.because: partial writes must not corrupt the database

preconditions: The TranscriptStore trait must be defined
The redb crate must be added as a dependency
A valid database path must be provided during initialization
postconditions: Transcripts are persisted to disk with ACID guarantees
Concurrent reads are supported without blocking
All write operations are atomic and durable
invariants: Database schema remains consistent across versions
Transcript IDs are unique within the database
Read operations always return consistent snapshots

happy: Verify saving a transcript persists it to the database
Verify loading a saved transcript returns identical data
Verify listing transcripts returns all stored transcripts in order
Verify deleting a transcript removes it from the database
error: Verify loading a non-existent transcript returns appropriate error
Verify database initialization fails gracefully with invalid path
Verify concurrent write operations are serialized correctly

phase_0: Check existing redb patterns in codebase
phase_2: Add error handling for redb errors

similar: See existing redb implementations in clarity-web
